title: Apple Sign-in
summary: Registers Sign in with Apple into the kernel sign-in shell. Services ID, Team/Key IDs, and the AuthKey PEM live on this plugin, not kernel JSON or config/*.p8.

blocks.title: Sign-in shell stays in the kernel
blocks.text: Session, OTP, unlock, and the HTTP routes stay kernel. This plugin owns provider credentials (settingsSchema / secrets). Disable the plugin to hide this method even if shop Preferences still list it.
Configure at Admin → Plugins → Apple Sign-in. Kernel identity reads via getCachedPluginSettings / getCachedPluginSecret using plugin id tuucho-signin-apple.

Bundled path: tuucho-config/plugins/tuucho-signin-apple/ (public config.json, gitignored config.private.json, committed config.private.example.json). Merge matches kernel JSON (common then env, private or example). Boot does not overwrite Admin values. First launch loads files once when settings are still empty. Edit in Admin → Plugins → Configure, or Update from files / Import / Export there. Admin → Plugins Update all / Import all / Export all uses the same files (schema plugins only; no extra register).

items.description: string — public. Services ID from Apple Developer (com.example.siwa). Required before Sign in with Apple appears on the shop.
string — public. 10-character Team ID. Required to sign the client secret with the .p8 key.
string — public. Key ID of the Sign in with Apple key (.p8) you downloaded.
string — public. Optional App ID used as the server-to-server audience. Leave empty unless Apple documents a separate App ID for this shop.
url — public. Must match Return URLs in the Services ID (this shop’s Apple return path). Wrong host = Apple error.
string — public. How long a first-time Apple signup token stays valid (for example 10m). Raise only if customers need longer to finish.
secret — secret. Contents of the .p8 key (-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY----- …). Paste a new PEM only to replace the stored key.
